title: 1 Mukhi Rudraksha
benefits: Traditionally associated with spiritual focus, leadership, clarity and detachment.
origin: Varies by specimen; commonly Nepal or Indonesia
about: The 1 Mukhi Rudraksha is traditionally regarded as a symbol of Lord Shiva and pure consciousness. It is revered in spiritual practice for meditation, clarity, detachment and single-pointed focus.

benefitDetails.title: General
benefitDetails.text: Clarity, focus, leadership and disciplined personal direction.

benefitDetails.title: Spiritual
benefitDetails.text: Traditionally associated with spiritual focus, leadership, clarity and detachment.

benefitDetails.title: Practice
benefitDetails.text: Traditionally used as a support for prayer, meditation, mantra japa and mindful spiritual discipline.

whoShouldWear: Meditators and serious spiritual seekers.
People seeking clarity, focus and disciplined leadership.
Those drawn to Shiva-oriented spiritual practice.
wearingRules: Traditionally worn after cleansing and prayer on an auspicious day; Monday is commonly preferred for Shiva-oriented practice.
Chant the listed mantra or Om Namah Shivaya with devotion before wearing.
Keep the bead clean and dry after bathing; avoid harsh chemicals, perfume and prolonged soaking.
Traditional practices vary by lineage, so follow the guidance of your family priest or spiritual teacher when applicable.

title: 1 Mukhi Savaar Rudraksha
benefits: Traditionally associated with Shiva consciousness, spiritual focus, clarity, confidence and disciplined personal direction.
mantra: Om Hreem Namah / Om Namah Shivaya
origin: Commonly Nepal
about: A Savaar (Savar/Sawar) Rudraksha is a rare naturally conjoined formation. In a 1 Mukhi Savaar, one portion of the joined formation has a single Mukhi and is traditionally associated with Lord Shiva.
